question: Does AArch64 expose a real MD5 instruction backend?

checks.source: md5h v0.4s, v1.4s, v2.4s; md5m; md5p; md5im
checks.result: all four mnemonics rejected as unrecognized instruction mnemonic

conclusion: AArch64 has no deployable MD5 instruction backend to add on this toolchain/host. Do not emit guessed raw encodings or add an md5 target feature that the architecture/toolchain does not define.
next_valid_targets: real hardware/vendor ISA with a documented MD5 extension
multi-message NEON/SVE batching where the workload permits independent messages
a different CPU architecture/backend with documented MD5 acceleration
